name: binpar-brand-voice
description: BinPar brand voice and writing style guide (es-ES): clinical sobriety in a conversational voice (nosotros, tú), naming and pronunciation, no personified AI, clinical and regulatory red lines, disclosure boundary, headline composition, format guidance (web, blog, video scripts and subtitles, LinkedIn, proposals, reports, PDFs, decks, emails, UI text) and a review mode with severities.
